result.title: Reconstructing Natural Images from Brain Activity during Natural Vision
result.comment: 40 pages, 18 figures, 4 tables. Includes supplementary material
result.summary: Reconstructing images from brain activity has two broad goals. The first is to build brain-computer interfaces. The second is to understand how the brain sees. The eyes deliver incomplete, noisy input, so the brain must fill in the gaps with its expectations of what natural scenes look like. This filling-in relies on the brain's prior over natural images. Image reconstruction lets us test which natural image prior best matches the brain's natural image prior. However, most previous work on image reconstruction relies on an unnatural condition: subjects must hold their eyes still. In reality, primates constantly move their eyes to see the world. We introduce a framework for reconstructing images from neural activity while a primate freely views a static natural scene. We record from five monkeys with high-density electrode arrays in the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) and primary visual cortex (V1). The recorded receptive fields cover only a small part of the image. Thus, we combine neural activity across eye movements, trials, and sessions to reconstruct the full image. We first present a simple linear method with a 1/f prior. We then scale this approach up with modern deep learning. We train a decoder by tokenizing spiking activity and measured gaze; these tokens are fed into a transformer and diffusion model to reconstruct the full scene. Three factors determine reconstruction quality: the amount of neural evidence combined over viewing time, the accuracy of eye tracking, and the choice of image prior. Our method sets a new state-of-the-art performance in reconstructing natural images from brain activity, across brain recording modalities: fMRI, EEG, MEG and electrophysiology.

AI.brief_summary: 该研究在猕猴自由注视静态自然场景时记录 LGN 与 V1 的高密度阵列活动，将脉冲与眼动 token 化后送入 transformer 与扩散模型，从局部感受野覆盖的神经信号跨眼动、试次与会话重建完整图像，并分析证据量、眼动追踪精度与图像先验对重建质量的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「跨注视累积视觉证据并依赖自然图像先验填补缺失输入」的框架，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、何时停止获取证据及内部视觉先验的作用提供概念参照，但属神经解码研究，与 VLM 推理机制的直接联系尚需核查。
